title: Finite Relational Source Parity V0
run_context: second-source finite relational adapter parity validation generated by omega.validation.finite_relational_source_parity
claim_boundary: Synthetic compiler-parity validation only. This checks that selected graph and grid sources compile to matching finite relational facts and audit findings after declared state renaming. It does not validate a real substrate, infer agency, prove value, certify identity, or validate Omega.
interpretation: This validates source-compiler parity for selected finite generated surfaces, not empirical correctness.
The strict-asymmetry case checks that graph and grid sources compile to matching primitive relation, separation, asymmetry, merge-separation, presentation, and audit findings after state renaming.
The recurrent-carrier case checks that graph and grid sources compile to matching recurrent carrier certification, merge-separation, presentation, and audit findings after state renaming.
The result helps guard against a single source compiler becoming the only path to the normalized finite relational IR.
